question: In India, the operation flood was launched in ______.
solution: The correct answer is __**1970**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Operation Flood** was launched in **1970** by the **National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)** of India. • It is considered one of the largest initiatives aimed at increasing **milk production** and making India the largest producer of milk globally. • The program was spearheaded by **Dr. Verghese Kurien**, known as the **"Father of the White Revolution"** in India. • It involved the creation of a nationwide milk grid, which connected rural milk producers with urban markets to ensure a consistent supply of milk and dairy products. • Operation Flood played a vital role in transforming India from a milk-deficient country to a self-sufficient and leading exporter of dairy products.
